release_notes: The till has a Receipts tab: find a receipt, open the saved sale, copy the reference, and reprint without creating another sale. A cashier can request a void; the receipt stays completed until it is approved. A signed-in Super Admin can void directly. Split payment can use any mix of cash, M-Pesa, card, and bank transfer, including three or more methods with no cash required. A credit remainder needs a customer and is not counted as money received. A pending M-Pesa line is not collected. Includes the inventory, product-removal, debt, and startup fixes from 3.1.73 and 3.1.74.
